idf-builder.description: ESP-IDF build system integration tool for compiling and managing ESP32 projects. Provides build, clean, and configuration management for firmware development. Requires ESP-IDF installation.

device-test.description: ESP32 I2C testing and verification server with dual-device support for Device Under Test (DUT) and I2C Sniffer Probe (TESTER). Provides I2C transaction monitoring, log merging, protocol verification, serial monitoring, firmware flashing, and comprehensive I2C communication analysis.

system.description: File system operations, documentation processing, and patch management. Supports PDF extraction, web page reading, file search and manipulation, patch application, and image analysis for technical diagrams.
